summary: Frontend smoke test on SchoolDashboard after compile-error fix. Verified counselor (/counselor) and principal (/principal) dashboards render correctly. Note: request mentioned /counselor/dashboard and /principal/dashboard but the actual configured routes are /counselor and /principal (see App.js). Both variants load without runtime errors, all 4 Bento stats render, and the view-students-{variant} links are visible with correct hrefs.

issues: Recharts warns 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on initial render — cosmetic warning only; charts render correctly after layout settles. Consider adding min-h to ResponsiveContainer parent.

action_items: Clarify route naming: request referred to /counselor/dashboard and /principal/dashboard but App.js defines /counselor and /principal. Update either routes or documentation.
critical_code_review_comments: SchoolDashboard.jsx: no error/failure state — if /school/overview 500s, loading spinner stays forever. Add error state and retry.
Unused state (showStudentForm, stForm, creating, createdStudent, createStudent, copyCreds) present in file with no UI to trigger them — dead code from removed section; consider removing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SchoolDashboard compiles fine (167 lines). Both /counselor and /principal render with 4 stats + view-students-{variant} link. Dead code (add-student form state and handlers) remains in file — no UI wired to it.
